description: One way of shooting across the sounds it ran under. By `id` (`flow.lineage.id` from shorti_format) or `format` (a format_id): its milestones oldest first, each with the change it made; how many took each kind of change, in words; the worlds it moved into; up to three changes nobody has made yet. What videos did, never a forecast.
